    "Comprehensive project visibility and reporting for marketing campaigns.",
    "Customizable workflows and spaces adapted to team needs.",
    "Scalability to manage projects across a larger marketing department."

  "cons": [
    "Initial setup and learning curve were somewhat steep.",
    "Interface could sometimes feel cluttered with many features.",
    "Cost was higher compared to previous, simpler tools."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "The Director of Marketing & Communications likely found Wrike to be a significant upgrade for managing complex projects and team tasks, especially coming from simpler tools. They appreciated its robust functionality and customization for marketing workflows and team visibility. While the initial learning curve and cost were notable, the benefits for a growing team outweighed these challenges, leading to a generally positive experience."
